definitions.explanation: A stand or holder designed to support a candle or multiple candles. Encompasses both simple single-candle holders and ornate multi-branched candelabras.

examples.japanese: {燭台|しょくだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ろうそく⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: To set a candle in a candlestick.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銀|ぎん}→銀：02651_gin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{燭台|しょくだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}かれていた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: A silver candlestick was placed on the table.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祭壇|さいだん}→祭壇：13739_saidan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{燭台|しょくだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Two large candelabras stood side by side on the church altar.

notes:
Composed of {燭|しょく} (candle, light) and {台|だい} (stand, platform). A word frequently encountered in literature, historical contexts, and descriptions of religious or ceremonial settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {燭台|しょくだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ろうそく⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to set a candle in a holder
- ⟦{銀|ぎん}→銀：02651_gin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{燭台|しょくだい}: silver candlestick
- {燭台|しょくだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧: candlestick flame
- {燭台|しょくだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to hold a candlestick

CULTURAL NOTE:
Famously appears in the novel Les Misérables (Japanese title: ⟦ああ→ああ：01147_aa⟧⟦{無情|むじょう}→無情：17075_mujou⟧ or レ・ミゼラブル), where a bishop gives silver candlesticks to Jean Valjean. Also commonly seen in descriptions of Buddhist altars and traditional Japanese settings.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦キャンドル→キャンドル：28904_kyandoru⟧⟦スタンド→スタンド：00394_sutando⟧: candle stand — loanword, more modern
- {灯明台|とうみょうだい}: lamp stand (for oil lamps) — traditional, especially in Buddhist contexts
